public_api_proposals_all_NEW: RequestAp(config, boot identity, request result): copy config under serialized admission; no WiFi/lwIP SDK. Return local request acceptance and requestId/epoch; one accepted management request at a time, reject another AP as busy instead of silently replacing it.
RequestOff(request result): immediate logical output gate/epoch change, no esp_wifi_stop/close/deinit. An old AP request is given a superseded terminal, not later applied in the new epoch.

SubmitDatagram(publication): channel/class, exact bytes/length, immutable peer or broadcast destination, absolute deadline, captured epoch, optional typed scientific identity. Deep copy before ESP_OK; never retain caller pointers.
CopyOwnerSnapshot/CopyChannelCounters/CopyRequestResult: one mux snapshot, no SDK, no allocation, safe before lazy initialization.
TakeTerminal/Completion callback outside owner mux: bounded POD results only; no socket, deinit, log or payload pointer loan.
ObserveDeadline(nowUs): timer only checks/latches active phase/call/epoch and frozen request outcome under the same mux; no log/alloc/free/socket/SDK/reset.

owner_and_storage.default_OFF: Software-only observations/callback registration allowed; no owner task, large stack, payload pool or WiFi SDK start. First AP request lazily creates persistent resources once. Partial allocation/timer/task failure is sticky and queryable; never memset/recreate live state.
owner_and_storage.task: Candidate owner priority5/core0 with 4096-byte internal stack, not yet stack-qualified. Existing wifiCtrl RX remains a separate persistent task and retains its current distinct WorkBudget role.
owner_and_storage.candidate_payload_pool: 2 x 2304 ordinary DATA/LOG + 1 x 2304 priority lifecycle + 1 x 512 CTRL = 7424 bytes, one explicit PSRAM|8BIT allocation, no internal fallback. This differs from the earlier 5632-byte candidate to preserve the public lifecycle 2304-byte maximum rather than truncate or silently downgrade it. Exact count requires root approval.
owner_and_storage.states: FREE -> WRITING -> PENDING -> OWNED -> completion known -> FREE. Notifications only wake; descriptor/slot/epoch state carries meaning. Admission mutex sections short, memcpy outside. No queue scan can reclaim a WRITING/OWNED slot.
owner_and_storage.queues: Fixed descriptor queues, zero-wait producer admission. CTRL/lifecycle before normal whenever owner is free; cannot preempt an in-flight SDK call. Retain exact full scientific bytes and normal DATA enqueue order. No payload overwrite to hide pressure.
owner_and_storage.deadline: Candidate datagram observer 500000us, poll100000us; candidate AP init/profile transaction total5000000us and cleanup1000000us, all named policy constants, not proven SDK timeouts. Queue deadline immutable; inherited protected deadline is min(existing remaining deadline, local policy), never refreshed on retry. WorkBudget waits count in transaction time.
owner_and_storage.guard: Timer uses ESP_TIMER_TASK + skip_unhandled_events. Atomic gate+beginSDK and finishSDK; finish observes elapsed time BEFORE clearing active. A quarantined epoch never starts another SDK call, including cleanup. Actual returned result/errno/bytes stored separately from first local deadline and cleanup errors.
owner_and_storage.late_return: A late full sendto increments actual completion/driver bytes and legacy wifiSent once, plus late-result evidence; it does not clear quarantine or resume owner work. The datagram may have reached a PC. A never-returning SDK keeps slot/socket/task/stack alive; no cancellation claim.
owner_and_storage.cleanup: Before RX task exists, owner may clean partial initialization under its own explicit deadline. After RX task starts, do not delete it or close/destroy its borrowed socket/netif while recvfrom may still be active. OFF is gate-only; retain backend resources. Uncertain partial startup requires quarantine, not blind HIGH->BLE_COMPAT retry.
owner_and_storage.fallback: Preserve at most one HIGH->BLE_COMPAT attempt only when first call returned and necessary cleanup is known successful; keep firstError and one total deadline. A hung/unknown cleanup never starts another attempt.
owner_and_storage.events: ESP event callback only records event/generation and marks station knowledge/reconciliation needed. No esp_wifi_ap_get_sta_list in event thread. Owner performs any required query as an observed SDK phase; event counts alone are not physical connection proof.
owner_and_storage.locks: One internal WiFi mux protects public state/admission/guard snapshots. No SDK, heap allocation, printf, Transport/BLE callbacks or other component lock while held. Completion and terminal publication occur after releasing it.

protocol_proposal.capability: Recommended CAPS2: append only /caps2_v1 (9 bytes) to both existing PROTO formats after real-formatter max tests; current longest501 would become510, still within512 with NUL. CAPS2?, read-only, returns CAPS2,v=1,page=1,caps=wifi_owner_v1,next=none. Keep old capability tokens and512 limit. WIFI? also declares ver=2 for its changed asynchronous command semantics. If actual max test fails, use versioned WIFI? self-discovery without adding PROTO; do not truncate.
protocol_proposal.AP_acceptance: ACK,cmd=WIFI,v=AP,ok=0,accepted=1,pending=1,id=...,epoch=...,ver=2. A request is applied only after required SDK phases really returned and epoch still matches. Repeated already-applied AP has explicit idempotent outcome, not silent ignore.
protocol_proposal.OFF: ACK uses applied output_gate semantics only, radio=unknown. Existing running radio/socket is not reported physically off.
protocol_proposal.terminal: Versioned WTERM cached by requestId + boot/session + epoch; outcomes applied/failed/superseded/quarantined; firstError and cleanupError distinct. Cache last two terminals plus active request so AP->OFF does not immediately erase the superseded AP result. Unknown/expired request query stays explicit.
protocol_proposal.query: WIFI? basic state/discovery; WIFIIO? phase/guard/init/firstErr/cleanupErr/callId/start/age/deadline/completionKnown/held resources/recovery limit; WIFIQ?D/L/C per-channel queued/full send completions/drop/expired/stale/partial/errno/driver bytes. Split lines rather than exceed512. All fields maximal-width/truncation tested.
protocol_proposal.terminal_progress_if_owner_stuck: Timer only latches. A bounded Transport poll/drain while a WiFi transaction is active must expose cached terminal even when the owner cannot return; only active/pending WiFi adds a finite wake timeout. Normal admission wakes Transport outside WiFi mux. Default OFF retains existing idle blocking behavior.
protocol_proposal.compatibility_counters: Do not call TransportStatResult(...ESP_OK) on WiFi queue admission. queued is new; wifiDataSent/wifiLogSent/wifiCtrlTx advance only from actual full sendto completion, via bounded callback outside WiFi mux. Admission rejection/expiry/stale/completion failure counted once per layer; active timeout remains completion unknown, not invented physical loss.
protocol_proposal.control_reply_barrier: Existing published hook means local sink admission; a copied CTRL queue success may open it, never a PC ACK. Request terminal/query reconstructs a lost or late reply. If implementation adds an AP ACK commit barrier, it needs its own finite uncommitted deadline and no extra blocking handler.
protocol_proposal.boot: Use real main session/boot hook before transport starts; do not generate a conflicting scientific session or silently use bootId0. No cross-boot request/epoch comparison; bounded u32 serial order and zero-skip wrap declared.
protocol_proposal.budget_observation: Append WIFI_OWNER role7 with independent writer; no reuse of WIFI_CTRL6. Keep old SCHEDWHY layout to stay<=512; expose role7 budget via WiFi query and CPUOWNER?7 additive support.
